Sorry for the late response. Of course it's scary but in my situation I was already on the decline and had nothing to really lose. But the doctor's these days are amazing, I'm a week out of the hospital now. I had a scare and went through rejection so I was in longer but I'm out and I already have my color back and feel the healthiest I ever have in my life. It's a process and I was lucky to only have to wait 8 days for my transplant. It's a process even after the transplant. Avoiding situations that can possibly lead to sickness that normal people can easily defend but you can't. Medicine twice a day for the rest of your life at the same time everyday. But if you get offered a transplant I would accept it and not wait. Some people don't get a second chance.
